paragraphs.text: The Adventurer is a selectable avatar in Magic: The Gathering Arena . In the tutorial stages of Arena, they encounter and fight various characters, including the Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas .

A hooded figure stands in the doorway, their face obscured by shadows. They do not speak, but mysterious power crackles at their fingertips. Who are they? What do they want? Their fate has yet to be written.
